outlook.statement: The Company will continue to invest its efforts in research, product development, quality and market expansion to meet the evolving needs of farmers and contribute meaningfully to the agricultural ecosystem.

The long-term outlook for the Indian seed industry remains encouraging due to increasing agricultural intensification, growing farmer awareness, demand for higher productivity, varietal replacement, climate change, technological development, and increasing adoption of quality seed. The Company intends to leverage these opportunities by strengthening its existing product portfolio, developing and commercializing improved varieties and hybrids, expanding into selected crop and geographical segments, strengthening seed production and processing capabilities, improving quality-control systems, expanding its dealer and distribution network, increasing farmer engagement and field demonstrations, strengthening R&D and varietal evaluation, exploring strategic collaborations and technology partnerships, and evaluating suitable export opportunities.
